Redbeard's Booty#000.src: Talk with Marston in the ocean at [-{~} {~} -{~}]

Redbeard's Booty#001.src: Ah, ahoy matey! Are ye here to get a glimpse of ol' Redbeard's sunken galleon as well?
Redbeard's Booty#001.speaker: Marston

Redbeard's Booty#002.src: A fine ship it once was, aye? Accordin' to the stories, it sank in one o' the greatest sea battles in history! The cap'n sank beneath the waves, ne'er to be seen again!
Redbeard's Booty#002.speaker: Marston

Redbeard's Booty#003.src: ...Say. Have ye ever wanted to go on a real treasure hunt? Ye look like someone with an eye for treasure, aye?
Redbeard's Booty#003.speaker: Marston

Redbeard's Booty#004.src: Good for ye then! I bought meself a real treasure map on Pirate Cove, a fine deal if ye ask me. And, if the jack wasn't fibbing, it leads to the feared Redbeard's real treasure!
Redbeard's Booty#004.speaker: Marston

Redbeard's Booty#005.src: I ventured 'round, spied some fine jacks at the island, and I collected a crew to join me on me grand, fantastic voyage!
Redbeard's Booty#005.speaker: Marston

Redbeard's Booty#006.src: O' course, there always be room for another! Ye joinin'? We could use another hand.
Redbeard's Booty#006.speaker: Marston

Redbeard's Booty#007.src: Aye! Let's find the booty and bring back some doubloons! Here be that map I snagged. Swim or whatever you landlubbers do to get to Pirate Cove. It'll be the first house to the right when ye arrive.
Redbeard's Booty#007.speaker: Marston

Redbeard's Booty#008.src: Find Marston's crew on Pirate Cove at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Redbeard's Booty#009.src: And that be when ye will...
Redbeard's Booty#009.speaker: Martim

Redbeard's Booty#010.src: Cor lad...ye don' look like a pirate ta me, and I be but a young lass!
Redbeard's Booty#010.speaker: Karkun

Redbeard's Booty#011.src: 's right, bucko. Who be ye, bargin' into our home in yer fancy armour 'n whatnot?
Redbeard's Booty#011.speaker: Martim

Redbeard's Booty#012.src: Ah, ye be accompanyin' Marston, eh? Well if ye insist on that, where be the man 'himself?
Redbeard's Booty#012.speaker: Argus

Redbeard's Booty#013.src: Comin' later? Hm. Well, more hands always be helpful. Let us go down to me ship, the Black Ring.
Redbeard's Booty#013.speaker: Karkun

Redbeard's Booty#014.src: So he told ye about the plan? We'll bathe in doubloons when we get back! Ah, me fair lass will be so happy.
Redbeard's Booty#014.speaker: Martim

Redbeard's Booty#015.src: Hop aboard the Black Ring down at the dock of Pirate Cove.

Redbeard's Booty#017.src: Aha, quick on yer feet, lad! Ye got 'ere before us!
Redbeard's Booty#017.speaker: Karkun

Redbeard's Booty#019.src: How's about we wait up fer him? He's the one who's givin us the opportunity fer this hunt, anyways.
Redbeard's Booty#019.speaker: Martim

Redbeard's Booty#020.src: I be getting impatient... The whole crew is 'ere, 'cept fer him!
Redbeard's Booty#020.speaker: Argus

Redbeard's Booty#021.src: Argh! Where be our mate? It be getting dark out! We will have to leave Marston at land.
Redbeard's Booty#021.speaker: Karkun

Redbeard's Booty#022.src: Do ya have the map Marston bought?
Redbeard's Booty#022.speaker: Karkun

Redbeard's Booty#023.src: Let us take a looksie at the map and see where to go.
Redbeard's Booty#023.speaker: Martim

Redbeard's Booty#024.src: It seems like one of these islands have the treasure... A'ight, yer in charge, landlubber! Set us on a course fer an island!
Redbeard's Booty#024.speaker: Argus

Redbeard's Booty#025.src: Ahoy, this must be the booty. Fret not, Argus is keepin' the ship prepared so we can leave.
Redbeard's Booty#025.speaker: Karkun

Redbeard's Booty#026.src: A'ight, let's us dig it up, jacks!
Redbeard's Booty#026.speaker: Martim

Redbeard's Booty#027.src: Aha, I see somethin' gleaming in there! Methinks we hit gold, lads.
Redbeard's Booty#027.speaker: Karkun

Redbeard's Booty#028.src: Now Martim, knock the lubber out.
Redbeard's Booty#028.speaker: Karkun

Redbeard's Booty#029.src: What? Another clue! The be just a wild grook hunt, where be the real booty?! No one ever got rich off a heap o' keys!! Maybe this 'ere jewel attached will sell...
Redbeard's Booty#029.speaker: Karkun

Redbeard's Booty#030.src: Wait, there be a clue on the key! Presented to the ruined Galleon, a true path forward will arise.
Redbeard's Booty#030.speaker: Martim

Redbeard's Booty#031.src: Garh...I be losin' my patience. Argus arrived, let's ditch the lubber before they awake, hm? This island be hidden by magic, ain't no way they're gettin' found.
Redbeard's Booty#031.speaker: Martim

Redbeard's Booty#032.src: Arright! This key... We might be able to bring Redbeard 'imself back to life... He'll strike terror in the seas again, and we will be 'is crew!
Redbeard's Booty#032.speaker: Karkun

Redbeard's Booty#033.src: Leave the hidden island and stop the pirates from stealing Redbeard's Booty.

Redbeard's Booty#034.src: Talk to Marston about his crew at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Redbeard's Booty#035.src: Can't say I expected all that... Those dogs are quick, eh?
Redbeard's Booty#035.speaker: Marston

Redbeard's Booty#036.src: Fer a landlubber, ye sure are quick. When I got ta Pirate Cove, ye were already but a speck on the horizon.
Redbeard's Booty#036.speaker: Marston

Redbeard's Booty#037.src: Speakin' of, what'n the name o' Davy Jones' Locket happened out there?!
Redbeard's Booty#037.speaker: Marston

Redbeard's Booty#038.src: Ye look a bit bruised! Reckon ye ran aground o' trouble with 'em too, eh?
Redbeard's Booty#038.speaker: Marston

Redbeard's Booty#039.src: Well, lad! Methinks ye oughta go in after 'em! We may be a rowdy lot, but a mutiny's somethin' ye don't tolerate.
Redbeard's Booty#039.speaker: Marston

Redbeard's Booty#040.src: They don't deserve that treasure, lad! It ain't be mine either, since I missed ye. That gold be yours fer the takin...so take it!
Redbeard's Booty#040.speaker: Marston

Redbeard's Booty#041.src: Speakin' of...I ain't got much a penny ta my name, but I found this fish while ye were gone. I hear it sells for a decent haul, so here.
Redbeard's Booty#041.speaker: Marston
